items.headline: Tanker shortage pushes freight rates to records
items.summary: Supertanker day rates have hit historic highs as the Iran war disrupts Hormuz routes, forcing longer voyages and tying up vessels, according to gCaptain and Vitol's CEO. Suezmax earnings have reportedly jumped roughly fivefold since the start of the month.

items.headline: EMIR REFIT shifts focus to reporting quality
items.summary: Per EIMF Insights, with EMIR REFIT go-live complete, EU/UK firms are now being pushed to prove their derivatives reports are accurate, timely and properly controlled rather than just successfully transmitted.

items.headline: Traders still keep manual position sheets, ETRM gaps
items.summary: CTRM Center reports that many commodity trading desks continue to maintain private position spreadsheets alongside functioning ETRM systems, pointing to persistent trust and data-granularity gaps in deployed platforms.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn loan package
items.summary: Trafigura closed syndicated revolving credit and term loan facilities worth about $4.4 billion, oversubscribed and larger than its initial $3.5bn launch, with 40 banks participating per GTR and Trafigura's own announcement. The deal adds a five-year tranche as part of a shift toward longer-dated funding.
